parsed.internal_thinking: I am first to place. Node 20 is the strongest overall production spot with 12 pips (Brick 6, Sheep 8, Wood 11). Node 43 has more pips (13) but is entirely Wheat, which is risky for early expansion. Node 20 provides the Wood/Brick combo needed for roads and settlements, plus high-probability Sheep. I'll secure node 20 to establish a strong base. Regarding the table, I'm still wary of Bob after that betrayal last game, and Charlie's involvement with him makes me cautious of both. I'll play it clean for now but I'm watching them.
parsed.note_to_self: Placed first settlement on node 20 (W11, B6, S8). High production, good for roads. Need to watch Bob's placement to block his expansion if possible.
parsed.say_outloud: Alright, let's get this started. I'll take the spot on the 6-8-11. And Bob, don't think I've forgotten how things ended last time—I'm keeping my eyes on you.
